task.title: P6-114: Sort move_batch items before locking to prevent deadlocks
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 1 — Destructive actions and data integrity). Original id: P6-114. Size: S. Specs: specs/collection-api.md.

**`move_batch` acquires `FOR UPDATE` locks in caller-supplied list order, so two concurrent overlapping batches in opposite order deadlock into a 502** (was `P6-055i`). One transaction iterating `req.items` in order (`hosted.rs:1015-1033`), locking at `:2062` (`holding_take`) and `:2107` (`holding_take_clamp`). Sorting the item set before locking fixes it.
